images.title: Filling a strip in fifths
images.purpose: Show a length measured by counting a fractional unit: 3 parts of 1/5 unit fill 3/5 of a 1 unit strip.
images.composition: One long strip across the middle of the frame, with a bracket above the filled parts and one line centred below.
images.exact_structure: One strip, 1 unit long, split into 5 exactly equal parts. The first 3 parts from the left are solid blocks filled teal #0072B2, numbered 1, 2, 3. The last 2 parts are hollow with dashed grey #6B7280 outlines. A reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket above the 3 blocks. A thin grey bracket under the whole strip. Exactly 1 strip, 5 equal parts, 3 filled, 2 hollow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any on-screen control, panel or app interface drawn in the frame
images.description: A 1 unit strip in 5 equal parts with 3 numbered teal blocks filled and 2 dashed parts empty; the bracket reads 3 × 1/5 = 3/5.
images.context: Shown with the doer concept before the student practises. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the filled blocks and say the length as a number of fifths.

image_decisions.why: A strip partly filled with unit blocks shows the one idea the practice uses: count the unit to measure.
